title: Two test orders
prompt: A teammate needs two made-up orders to test a report with. Write `solve()` so it returns them as a DataFrame with exactly the same columns and types as `orders`.
rules: Columns, in order: `order_id`, `customer_id`, `order_date` (date), `status`, `channel`, `total` (decimal(10,2)). The others are text.
Order `T0001`: customer `C0001`, 1 July 2026, `placed`, `web`, and no total yet: the total is missing.
hints: One schema string names all six columns: `"order_id STRING, ..., total DECIMAL(10,2)"`.
A date is `date(2026, 7, 1)` and an exact amount is `Decimal("45.50")`. Both are imported in the starter.
